thread:
elaine: Heads-up — brainstorming token-runway visuals for the benchmark launch. Need a 1-slide hero + 2 detail charts. Who can own the chart specs?

matt: I can draft specs. My thinking: 1) scatter of latency vs $/1k tokens across model/configs, 2) p50/p95/p99 latency CDF by workload slice, 3) small bar comparing cost per typical request lengths.

sarah: @matt that sounds good. Can you add suggested color palettes? We should keep brand colors but make the econ lines pop. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

elaine: Prefer the hero to be a single simple visual that immediately answers: "how much faster/cheaper is Redwood in common configs?" Then deep-dive tabs for the rest.

ravi: For the hero, what about a compact 2x2 tile: latency delta vs baseline and token-cost delta vs baseline, with arrows and %s? Quick visual punch.

matt: Love that. Hero spec idea: left half = latency delta bar (ms, log scale if needed), right half = cost delta ($/1k tokens). Callouts for p95 latency and median cost.

sarah: I can mock the tile once I have the numbers. Need a CSV of the baseline and our variants. @leo can you export the top 5 workload slices from bench infra?

leo: I'll export. Which slices? I suggest: chat-concise (8-32 tokens), chat-long (200-800), completion-short (32-128), embedding-seq (varied), rerank-small. Will share a Drive link in 20m.

design-bot: Figma template created: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/bench-visual-templates - hero_tile_v1 frame ready. Sarah please duplicate and drop numbers.

matt: Chart config notes I'm putting here so it's easy to implement: ```
scatter: x=median_latency_ms, y=cost_per_1k_tokens, point=model_variant, size=throughput, color=tier
cdf: plot p50/p95/p99 lines per model, facet by workload_slice
bar: x=request_length_bin, y=cost_per_request, stacked=quantization_level
```

elaine: Also add short copy variants to test in the deck: 1) "Faster responses, lower token cost — real workloads." 2) "Optimize latency and unit economics with one runtime." 3) "Same model, better serving economics." We'll A/B those in the landing post.

sarah: Copy 2 has my vote. It's concise and product-y. 

ravi: For the webinar demo path, propose 3 segments: 1) benchmarks + methodology (5m), 2) live demo of routing/fallbacks affecting latency (10m), 3) customer econ case study (10m) + Q&A.

matt: For methodology slide please call out: dataset, prompt templates, tokenization rules, concurrency pattern, and that we've pinned model weights. Short bullet list.

elaine: Action items: matt - draft chart CSV (due EOD), leo - upload slices (in 20m), sarah - mock hero once CSVs live (tomorrow AM), ravi - outline webinar demo script (tomorrow). We'll review mock in standup. :white_check_mark:
